name: zrndr_fog_blend_span_555_mmx
description: zRndr::FogBlendSpan555Mmx blends a 5:5:5 destination span using scalar edge handling and an aligned four-pixel MMX fog body.
known_limits: Guarded raw MMX under RECOIL_ENABLE_ZRNDR_SPAN_MMX_RAW_ASM now preserves the BN-proven four-pixel fog blend body and quad store; VC5SP3 byte verification with vc5_o2_ob0_md_zrndr_span_mmx_raw_asm_facs still fails with 284 unmasked mismatches. The expected C4799 no-EMMS warning is retained because retail has no emms in this function.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49e560 validates scalar leading alignment handling through zRndr::FogBlendSpan555Scalar, aligned four-pixel MMX body processing, four-lane fog-factor packing into gRndr_SpanShade16_MmxFogFactors, 5:5:5 MMX channel masks, destination quad stores, and scalar tail handling.
The native smoke initializes the 5:5:5 MMX masks, verifies a five-pixel span covering the aligned quad body and scalar tail, and checks the recovered four-lane fog-factor packing side effect.
